sn35.24:1.1: “Bhikkhus, I will teach you the Dhamma for abandoning all.
sn35.24:1.3: “And what, bhikkhus, is the Dhamma for abandoning all?
sn35.24:1.4: The eye is to be abandoned, forms are to be abandoned, eye-consciousness is to be abandoned, eye-contact is to be abandoned, and whatever feeling arises with eye-contact as condition—whether pleasant or painful or neither-painful-nor-pleasant—that too is to be abandoned.
sn35.24:1.8: The mind is to be abandoned, mental phenomena are to be abandoned, mind-consciousness is to be abandoned, mind-contact is to be abandoned, and whatever feeling arises with mind-contact as condition—whether pleasant or painful or neither-painful-nor-pleasant—that too is to be abandoned.
sn35.24:1.9: “This, bhikkhus, is the Dhamma for abandoning all.”
